name: loader_windows
author: jm33-ng
comment: Generate a self-unpacking Windows loader (service exe, plain exe, or DLL) that early-bird injects RC4-encrypted Donut sRDI shellcode (e.g. the agent.exe.bin produced by `agent generate --type exe`) into a sacrificial process (dllhost.exe, svchost.exe). The stager carries the real loader as an RC4-encrypted DLL and reflectively maps it in memory; the loader decrypts the blob, injects and verifies the child. Injection syscalls are indirect and, on x64, spoofed with SilentMoonwalk.
help: Build a self-unpacking Windows loader for a Donut sRDI shellcode blob. The loader early-bird injects the shellcode into a sacrificial process and is packaged as a service (default), a plain executable, or a DLL exporting Run(). Build the Windows agent first with generate; pass its shellcode_file as --shellcode, never the DLL. arch must match the shellcode. smw=on (default on x64) uses SilentMoonwalk and requires nasm on the C2; smw=off drops that dependency. With inject=ct choose a long-lived sacrificial process such as notepad.exe; the default apc injection parks the process. output defaults next to the shellcode with _svc.exe, .exe, or .dll appended. The returned artifact path is the deliverable; do not execute it on the operator host. Installing the service on the target needs administrator rights; remove it with sc delete.

parameters.name: shellcode
parameters.description: Path to the Donut sRDI shellcode (.bin) on the C2, e.g. the agent.exe.bin generated by `agent generate`

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output path (default: <shellcode dir>/<name>_svc.exe for service, <name>.exe for exe, <name>.dll for dll)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Host container to build: service = resident Windows service that injects once and stays up until stopped (default), exe = plain console executable, dll = DLL exporting Run() for in-memory or normal loading

parameters.name: process
parameters.description: Sacrificial process to spawn and inject into: bare name resolved under System32 (dllhost.exe, svchost.exe, ...) or a full path

parameters.name: process-args
parameters.description: Optional command-line arguments for the sacrificial process (the primary thread is parked before its code runs, so these rarely matter)

parameters.name: arch
parameters.description: Architecture of the shellcode and of the generated loader; must match the Donut blob

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: RC4 key as hex (1..256 bytes); leave empty to generate a fresh random key per build

parameters.name: inject
parameters.description: Load method baked into the loader: apc = early-bird QueueUserAPC into a parked sacrificial (default), ct = classic CreateRemoteThread (sacrificial must stay alive, e.g. notepad.exe or a real service host)

parameters.name: smw
parameters.description: SilentMoonwalk call-stack spoofing for the loader's indirect syscalls (x64 only): on (default) or off. Off also drops the nasm build dependency.

parameters.name: verify-ms
parameters.description: Milliseconds to watch the spawned process after injection before declaring success (default 5000, 0 skips the check)

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Keep verbose diagnostics in the binary (default false: production builds compile all logging out)
